title: Artifact
description: Schema for artifact.json — the manifest of a cookbook artifact source folder (cookr format 2). `meta` holds what a compiled doc shows as YAML frontmatter; `parts` lists, in order, the part files that compose the artifact's body. Identity is `meta.id` (a UUID); the readable rdid and the folder path live in the cookbook's index.json (index.schema.json), never here. cookr's type registry (skills/cookr/cli/cookr/core/artifact_types.py) checks the per-type section rules this schema cannot express.

format.description: Folder format version. cookr reads only format 2; `cookr upgrade` converts older folders.

id.description: The artifact's identity: a UUID, stable across renames and moves.

languages.description: Programming languages a guideline is specific to.

names_hosts.description: Why this artifact's shared text names a host or model family from cookr's host manifest (e.g. it documents Claude Code's file layout). Without it, naming one is a neutrality failure: host-specific wording belongs in hosts/ additions.

routes.description: skill-router routes for the compiled `skill` target, replacing the derived ones (cookr core/skill.py). Each is tiers separated by `/`, synonyms within a tier by `,`.

synced.description: Digest of the compiled doc cookr last wrote from (or folded into) this folder, so a doc and folder that disagree say which one changed. Written by cookr.

twin_differs.description: Why this guideline says something different from its twins under other use cases (cookr core/twins.py). Absent: it must say the same.

informational.description: Why this guideline states no MUST/SHOULD/MAY rule (cookr core/twins.py). Absent: it must state one.

parts.description: The body, in order. The intro (no heading) comes first; history (`## Change History`) comes last. Each part's text is `<part>.md` beside artifact.json, without its heading line.

links.description: Links as cookr stores them: a local artifact's UUID, or `<cookbook-uuid>/<artifact-uuid>` for another cookbook's. An rdid may be authored here; `cookr update` replaces it with the UUID.
